name: Keira Georgievna Gurdjieva
original_name: キーラ・ゲオルギエヴナ・グルジェワ
source:
A haughty woman with mysterious eyes who leads the Gunmetal Hounds. Prefers using the language of violence with everyone save for her cherished soldiers. 

[spoiler]She is one of the three daughters of George Ivanovich Gurdjiev, a Russian-born mystic. Gurdijeva both loathes and respects him.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]Her golden mystic eyes have the power to subjugate people.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]Her true form is a result of her father's experiments to produce a superhuman. He believed that he could achieve a more developed form of man by connecting body parts of other people to a specific human. This is exactly what he had done by connecting the body parts of Gurdijeva's sisters to her.[/spoiler]
